scenicChapters.title: Atlantic Road Coastal Bridges fuel gate → Oslo / Norway Scenic Roads r
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 77 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
